name: Shiki no Koi
source:
There is a rumor....
Sometimes, people could see a shop on that empty lot...
The people who can see it will enter the shop.
But after they fulfill their fate and gain something, the shop will never appear again before them...

Love...
Memory....
Longing...

Whatever your deepest desire is, they will grant it...

[Edited from [url=http://ruinyan.deviantart.com/art/Visual-Novel-Game-Shiki-no-Koi-445325754]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
有传言……
有时，人们会在那片空地上看到一家商店……
看到它的人就会进入商店。
但当他们完成命运并有所收获后，这家商店就再也不会出现在他们面前了……

爱…
记忆….
渴望…

无论你最深切的愿望是什么，他们都会满足…

[编辑自[url=http://ruinyan.deviantart.com/art/Visual-Novel-Game-Shiki-no-Koi-445325754]异常艺术[/url]]
